summary: Iteration 18: Tenable VM Integration testing complete. All 32 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Features verified: Settings management (save/get/delete API credentials), Demo mode sync (10 vulns + 12 compliance checks), Dashboard with stats/vuln breakdown/compliance donut/NIST control impact/assets, Findings list with filters, Control evidence endpoint, Sync history. Frontend: Tenable card on Integrations page, 4-tab dashboard (Dashboard/Vulnerabilities/Compliance Checks/Settings), all UI elements functional.
seed_data_creation: Demo data loaded via POST /api/tenable/sync with mode=demo. 10 vulnerabilities and 12 compliance checks mapped to 34 NIST controls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 tested Tenable VM Integration. Key endpoints: (1) POST /api/tenable/settings - save Tenable.io API credentials (access_key, secret_key). (2) GET /api/tenable/settings - returns configured status, masked access_key, last_sync. (3) DELETE /api/tenable/settings - removes credentials. (4) POST /api/tenable/sync - syncs data with mode=demo|auto|live. Demo mode loads 10 vulns + 12 compliance checks. Auto uses demo if no keys configured. Live requires valid Tenable.io keys. (5) GET /api/tenable/dashboard - returns total_findings, vulnerabilities (total, by_severity, by_state, open_critical), compliance (total, passed, failed, pass_rate), controls_impacted, control_impact dict, assets_scanned, assets list, sync_history. (6) GET /api/tenable/findings - list findings with optional filters: finding_type (vulnerability|compliance), severity (critical|high|medium), status. (7) GET /api/tenable/control-evidence/{control_id} - returns evidence for specific NIST control with vulnerabilities, compliance_checks, summary. (8) GET /api/tenable/sync-history - list of sync runs. Frontend: Tenable card on Integrations page (data-testid='tenable-open-btn'), TenableIntegration component with 4 tabs (data-testid='tab-dashboard|vulns|compliance|settings'), stats cards, vuln severity bars, compliance donut, NIST control impact grid, assets list, settings form with API key inputs.
